subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Flow State
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Flow State.

hook.text: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi studied flow for decades. In flow, people report time distortion and peak output.

buildup.text: Flow requires a balance: the task must be challenging enough to engage but not so hard it creates anxiety.

discovery.text: Clear goals, immediate feedback, and minimal interruptions are the three entry conditions for flow.

twist.text: Flow takes 15 to 25 minutes to enter but only seconds to break. One notification shatters it.

climax.text: Design your environment for flow: phone silent, notifications off, door closed, single task chosen.

punchline.text: Flow is fragile. Build a fortress around it.

quiz.question: What three conditions are needed to enter a flow state?
options: Clear goals, immediate feedback, and minimal interruptions
